profile.name: HDLC通信编解码器
profile.description: 用于对字节流进行 HDLC 成帧、转义、校验和解码的通信组件。它常用于实验系统中与采用 HDLC 风格链路层协议的仪器或嵌入式设备交换数据包；本体并非独立物理仪器，而是位于数据流接口上的协议处理模块。
profile.description_en: A communication component for HDLC framing, byte escaping, checksum calculation, and packet decoding on a byte stream. It is commonly used in laboratory systems to exchange packets with instruments or embedded devices that use an HDLC-style link layer. It is not a standalone physical instrument, but a protocol-processing element on top of a stream interface.
